mapper.sql: id, consumer, event_id AS eventId, status, lease_token AS leaseToken, attempt_count AS attemptCount, last_error AS lastError, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mq_consume_log ( consumer, event_id, status, lease_token, attempt_count, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{consumer}, #{eventId}, #{status}, #{leaseToken}, #{attemptCount}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE mq_consume_log SET status = 'FAIL', last_error = #{error}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken}
UPDATE mq_consume_log SET status = 'PROCESSING', lease_token = #{newLeaseToken}, attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'FAIL'
